actual: TDXScheduler builds daily and weekly schedule jobs without an explicit timezone. On a host whose local timezone is UTC+1, options.at=20:30 is persisted as 19:30 UTC and executes at 03:30 Asia/Shanghai instead of the intended A-share post-close time. The scheduler must bind canonical ingestion schedule times to Asia/Shanghai, preserve visible next_run_at UTC conversion, and retain existing frequency/date-strategy behavior without fallback.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
